references.text: Here the materials to be collected for the tabernacle are mentioned, including red-dyed ram skins and taḥash skins, the same materials used for the covering in Exod 26:14.
Repeats the list of materials given for the tabernacle, including red-dyed ram skins and taḥash skins for the covering.
Describes how the people brought red-dyed ram skins and taḥash skins as gifts for the construction of the tabernacle.
The fulfillment of the command in Exod 26:14, where the craftsmen actually made the covering from red-dyed ram skins and taḥash skins over the tabernacle.
Mentions the covering of red-dyed ram skins and the covering of taḥash skins as part of the finished work brought to Moses.
The responsibility of the Gershonites included carrying the tabernacle coverings, including the taḥash skin covering that was on top.
Direct continuation of the building instructions showing the layering: goat hair underneath, and ram skins and takassh skins above.
